channel.title: Humanoids Daily
channel.description: We bring you the latest developments in robotics, with a special focus on humanoid robots and intelligent machines. From groundbreaking research to real-world applications, we cover the people, technologies, and innovations shaping the future of robotics.

item.title: Boston Dynamics Puts Atlas on Wheels to Push Its Motors to the Limit
item.description: Boston Dynamics swapped Atlas's feet for scooter wheels on the ankle actuators and retrained its whole-body RL controller to roll, drift and spin-jump. It is a motor stress test, not a product.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: PrimeBOT Builds Its 10,000th Personal Robot, 14 Days After Its 5,000th
item.description: PrimeBOT says its 10,000th Q1 and T1 personal robot rolled off the line on November 8, with daily capacity at 240 units. It has not disclosed sales or deliveries.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Figure’s HQ Is Crawling With Figure 03 Robots. What Are They All Doing?
item.description: Two new videos from Brett Adcock show dozens of Figure 03 humanoids roaming Figure’s headquarters, inside and out. The company is close to having more robots than employees, but has said little about how many are doing paid work.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Atlas Battery Pack to Use 70 Samsung SDI Cells, Report Says
item.description: The reported 1.3 kWh pack adds detail to Atlas’s power system as humanoid makers pursue battery swapping, fast charging and new chemistries.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Inside Unitree's Hangzhou Factory, Robots Are Still Mostly Built by Hand
item.description: Josef Chen's visit to Unitree's Hangzhou factory, and the company's own filings, show a robot maker running on manual assembly with about $50 of machinery per robot. He argues US wages and trade barriers make factory automation far more valuable to American robot makers.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Swiss Startup Embodied AI Unveils AIR, a Wheeled Robot Built to Work Beside Factory Staff Without a Cage
item.description: The EPFL spin-off's two-armed robot starts each job under remote control and, the company says, takes the task over within a month. It reports a 95% average success rate in paid pilots.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tokyo Researchers Build Robotic Legs With 3D-Printed Muscles, Tendons and Ligaments
item.description: University of Tokyo researchers combine flexible printed structures with motor-driven wires to demonstrate supported stepping, offering a different take on bio-inspired robotics from Clone.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Apple's HALO Teaches a Unitree G1 to Navigate Unseen Rooms With Simulation-Generated Data
item.description: Trained on 300 hours of generated motion in simulated rooms, the onboard system completed 91% of 360 real-world trials without any teleoperation data.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: CMU Introduces Pixel, a Sub-$15,000 Wheeled Robot Designed to Learn From Human Demonstrations
item.description: Pixel combines a low-cost two-armed robot with human demonstration tools and whole-body learning. Its companion Pixel-UMI study reports 87% average task progress across five tasks.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: NEURA Robotics Partners With E.ON and enviaM on Grid Robotics, With Trials Expected in 2027
item.description: The partners will train robotic skills at TUM RoboGym before testing inspections, asset monitoring and worker-support applications with grid operator MITNETZ STROM.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: XPENG Highlights GroundingPI, a Vision Model for More Data-Efficient Robot Learning
item.description: GroundingPI improves simulated robot manipulation with fewer demonstrations, offering a specialized visual foundation rather than an announced upgrade to XPENG’s IRON humanoid.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Agility Begins Trading on Nasdaq as AGLT, the First US-Listed Pure-Play Humanoid Company
item.description: The Churchill XI merger closed with about $465 million in gross capital, below the $600 million-plus projected in June, as Agility debuts with $1.78 million in 2025 sales.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: NYU's MABEL Puts a 56-DOF Mobile Bimanual Robot on an $8,056 Open-Source Parts List
item.description: The open-source robot pairs two 7-DOF arms and 17-DOF ORCA hands with a lift and swerve base, and is teleoperated end to end with an Apple Vision Pro.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: RoboColosseum Launches Real-World Robot AI Benchmark With Unitree Support
item.description: The initiative offers more than 100 robots and 10,000 free evaluation hours, while initial G1 tests reveal how far robot policies remain from reliably completing tasks.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: KIST’s KAPEX Humanoid Reportedly Uses Over 90% Korean-Made Core Components
item.description: The update details KAPEX’s domestic supply chain and commercialization partnerships, building on KIST’s wider humanoid ambitions.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tokio Marine HCC and Adrian Flux Launch UK Home Insurance for Humanoid Robots
item.description: The household insurance offering covers domestic humanoid risks including theft, damage and personal liability, with individually priced quotes for UK customers.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: RobotWorld 2026 Opens With Humanoids and Physical AI in Focus
item.description: The Korean robotics exhibition brings together 402 companies from 17 countries, with a new humanoid pavilion and demonstrations spanning robot hands and factory automation.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: LiberAI Unveils Liber-0: Learning from Human Experience for Zero-Shot Robot Manipulation
item.description: LiberAI's Liber-0 world action model learns from more than 2.2 million hours of human experience and reached 36.0% success on 60 GPT-6-proposed tasks without task-specific robot demonstrations.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Schaeffler to Cut 3,460 Jobs in Europe, Names Humanoid Robotics as a Growth Area
item.description: The German supplier will close five sites and expects €480 million in one-time costs, while pointing to humanoid robotics and defense to absorb part of the reduction.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: This Week in Humanoids: Meta’s Reported Max, Factory Robots and Lumi’s Next Step
item.description: Our November 3 newsletter covers Meta and Fourier, factory robot trials, funding news and our interview with Lightberry’s CEO.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Churchill XI Shareholders Approve Agility Robotics Merger Ahead of Expected November 4 Closing
item.description: Shareholders approved the Agility Robotics merger on November 2. Closing is expected November 4, followed by Nasdaq trading under AGLT on November 5.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AiMOGA Opens Global Pre-Orders for MOBO Home Companion Robot
item.description: Chery’s AiMOGA is moving into home companionship with MOBO, a 22-DoF robot with claimed long-term memory, as it explores shared AI capabilities with vehicles.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Neura CEO David Reger Explains Why He Rejects Military Robotics
item.description: In a DW interview, David Reger argues that civilian robotics and industrial productivity offer Europe a stronger path forward than military contracts.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Xiaomi Shows Humanoids Sorting Car Parts in Eight-Hour Factory Demonstration
item.description: Xiaomi’s latest video shows two humanoids sorting center-console side covers over an eight-hour task, with claimed autonomous error recovery and production-line coordination.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Humanoid Robot Batteries Could Become an $850 Million Market by 2037, IDTechEx Forecasts
item.description: IDTechEx forecasts an $850 million humanoid battery market by 2037, as manufacturers pursue fast charging, battery swapping and new chemistries to extend working time.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: New Figure 03 Robots Walk Out of BotQ in Brett Adcock’s Latest Video
item.description: Brett Adcock shares newly manufactured Figure 03 robots walking across campus from BotQ, offering a glimpse of the fleet without new production or delivery figures.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: DEEP Robotics Humanoids Join Traffic Police at Hangzhou Marathon
item.description: Hangxing No.2 humanoids based on DEEP Robotics’ DR02 platform supported traffic operations around Huanglong Sports Center during the November 1 race.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Lightberry’s Lumi Gains Conditional FCC Covered List Exemption
item.description: CEO Ali Attar tells Humanoids Daily that Lumi’s exemption clears the way to apply for FCC certification, with shipments expected “very soon” but no firm date.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: 1X Teammates Use Spare NEO Heads to Test Home Integrations, Starting With the TV
item.description: A clip shared by Dar Sleeper shows a NEO head called Dexter choosing and playing The Lord of the Rings on a TV as teammates test home integrations.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AGIBOT Livestreams Six G2 Robots in a 24-Hour Convenience Store Challenge
item.description: Six G2 robots face rush-hour service, overnight duty and breakfast preparation in AGIBOT’s November 2–3 livestreamed store challenge.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)
